RETURN-001.title: Standard Return Window
RETURN-001.rule: Most electronics, fashion and home goods are eligible for return within 7 days of delivery. Item must be unused, in original packaging, and accompanied by the invoice.

RETURN-002.title: Damaged on Arrival
RETURN-002.rule: If an item is delivered damaged, customers must report within 48 hours with photo evidence. Eligible for free replacement or full refund regardless of standard return window.

REFUND-001.title: Refund Timeline
REFUND-001.rule: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after the returned item passes quality check at our warehouse. UPI and wallet refunds typically settle in 1-2 days; card/net-banking refunds in 5-7 days.

WARRANTY-001.title: Manufacturer Warranty
WARRANTY-001.rule: All electronics carry the manufacturer warranty as listed on the product page. ShopEase facilitates warranty claims but service is provided by the brand's authorized service center.

DELIVERY-001.title: Lost Shipment
DELIVERY-001.rule: If a shipment shows no tracking updates for 7+ days or is marked lost by the carrier, ShopEase will initiate a free replacement or full refund after internal verification. High-value items (above INR 50,000) are flagged for senior review.

COUPON-001.title: Coupon Application Rules
COUPON-001.rule: Coupons are applied only if the cart meets the minimum order value and category restrictions stated on the offer. Coupons cannot be combined unless explicitly marked as stackable.

COUPON-FESTIVE10.title: FESTIVE10 Specifics
COUPON-FESTIVE10.rule: FESTIVE10 gives 10% off (max INR 1500 discount) on orders above INR 30,000. Not valid on Apple, gift cards or grocery items.
